name: NocoDB
description: Read NocoDB workspaces, bases, tables, and records from NocoDB Cloud or a self-hosted instance. 7 read-only tools using xc-token API key authentication against the v3 REST API.
instructions:
This connector uses the NocoDB v3 API and is read-only.

**Setup**:
1. In NocoDB, open Team & Settings > API Tokens and create a token. Use a token with read-only access where possible; this adapter never sends write requests.
2. Set `NOCODB_API_TOKEN` to that token.
3. Set `NOCODB_URL` to the root NocoDB host, with no trailing slash. For NocoDB Cloud use `https://app.nocodb.com`. For self-hosted NocoDB use your own host, for example `https://nocodb.example.com`.

**Authentication**: NocoDB API tokens use the `xc-token` header. This adapter sends the header correctly. API tokens apply to the entire NocoDB instance; to limit access, create a token from a user account that only has the needed permissions.

**Discovery order**: call `nocodb_list_workspaces` first, then `nocodb_list_bases` for the workspace you want, then `nocodb_list_tables` for the base. IDs follow a chain: workspace IDs start with `w`, base IDs start with `p`, table IDs start with `m` or use a longer alphanumeric string, and record IDs are numeric. Always discover IDs from the parent level before querying the child level.

**Records and filtering**: before filtering or sorting records, call `nocodb_get_table` to learn the exact field names and types. The `where` parameter uses the NocoDB filter syntax: `(field,eq,value)` for a single condition, joined with `~and` or `~or` for multiple conditions, for example `(Status,eq,Open)~and(Priority,eq,High)`. The `sort` parameter is JSON: one object or an array of objects with `field` and `direction` (`asc` or `desc`), for example `[{"field":"CreatedAt","direction":"desc"}]`. Field names must exactly match what `nocodb_get_table` returns.

**Pagination**: `pageSize` is silently capped at 100 on NocoDB Cloud and 1000 on self-hosted instances. Use `nocodb_count_records` to learn the total before paging through large tables.

**Rate limiting**: NocoDB enforces approximately 5 requests per second per user, shared by all of the user's tokens. If the limit is hit, the API returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header (see https://nocodb.com/docs/apis/errors).

**Self-hosted instances**: if the NocoDB host is private or resolves to private address space, self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and allow the host through `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; otherwise the outbound guard blocks the request. On AnythingMCP Cloud, only publicly reachable NocoDB instances work.

**Community Edition note**: unlicensed self-hosted NocoDB may have a single implicit workspace. In that case, `nocodb_list_workspaces` may return one entry or an empty list; proceed directly to `nocodb_list_bases` with the known workspace ID or skip to tables if the base ID is already known.

**Out of scope**: creating, updating, or deleting records, tables, bases, or workspaces; views APIs (plan-gated); attachments; webhooks; and the deprecated v1/v2 APIs.
prerequisites: A NocoDB Cloud account or a self-hosted NocoDB instance reachable over HTTPS, and an API token created under Team & Settings > API Tokens. About 2 minutes.

NOCODB_URL.label: NocoDB URL
NOCODB_URL.help: The address you open NocoDB at, without a trailing slash: https://app.nocodb.com on NocoDB Cloud, or your own NocoDB's address.
NOCODB_URL.patternMessage: Enter the full address starting with https://, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://app.nocodb.com.

NOCODB_API_TOKEN.label: API token
NOCODB_API_TOKEN.help: In NocoDB open Team & Settings > API Tokens and create a token. Paste the token value here.
NOCODB_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the API token, without extra spaces.

verifyHints.401: NocoDB refused the token: it is wrong, expired or deleted. Create a new token under Team & Settings > API Tokens.
verifyHints.403: NocoDB accepted the token but the user does not have permission for this resource. Check the token owner's workspace and base permissions.
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this address. Check NOCODB_URL: the address you open NocoDB at, without /api and without a trailing slash.
verifyHints.429: NocoDB is rate limiting this token. Wait a moment and verify again.

tools.name: nocodb_list_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces visible to the configured API token. Call this first to discover workspace IDs (prefixed with w) and names, then use a workspace ID with nocodb_list_bases. Read-only.

tools.name: nocodb_list_bases
tools.description: List bases (projects) in a NocoDB workspace. Each base has an ID prefixed with p. Use nocodb_list_workspaces first to get the workspace ID, then pass it here to discover base IDs for nocodb_list_tables. Read-only.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID from nocodb_list_workspaces, prefixed with w, for example w_abc123def.

limit.description: Maximum number of bases to return per page.

offset.description: Number of bases to skip for pagination, starting from 0.

tools.name: nocodb_list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a NocoDB base. Each table has an ID prefixed with m or a longer alphanumeric string. Use nocodb_list_bases first to get the base ID, then pass it here. Read-only.

baseId.description: Base ID from nocodb_list_bases, prefixed with p, for example p_abc123def.

tools.name: nocodb_get_table
tools.description: Get the full schema of one NocoDB table: its columns with names, types, and options. Call this before nocodb_list_records so you have the exact field names needed for where, sort, and fields parameters. Read-only.

baseId.description: Base ID from nocodb_list_bases, prefixed with p, for example p_abc123def.

tableId.description: Table ID from nocodb_list_tables, for example m_abc123def.

tools.name: nocodb_list_records
tools.description: List records from a NocoDB table. Call nocodb_get_table first for exact field names, then use them in where, sort and fields. where uses (field,eq,value) joined with ~and or ~or; sort is JSON such as [{"field":"CreatedAt","direction":"desc"}]. Returns records plus pagination links; pageSize is silently capped at 100 on Cloud and 1000 on self-hosted. Read-only.

baseId.description: Base ID from nocodb_list_bases, prefixed with p, for example p_abc123def.

tableId.description: Table ID from nocodb_list_tables, for example m_abc123def.

where.description: NocoDB filter string. Single condition: (field,eq,value). Multiple: (field,eq,value)~and(field,gt,10). Operators: eq, neq, gt, ge, lt, le, like, nlike, is, isnot. Use exact field names from nocodb_get_table.

sort.description: Sort as JSON: one object or an array of objects with field and direction (asc or desc), for example [{"field":"CreatedAt","direction":"desc"}]. Use exact field names from nocodb_get_table.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use exact names from nocodb_get_table.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination. Start with 1.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page. Silently capped at 100 (Cloud) or 1000 (self-hosted). Use a modest size such as 25.

viewId.description: Optional view ID to read records through a specific view's filters and sorts.

tools.name: nocodb_get_record
tools.description: Get one record by its numeric row ID from a NocoDB table. Use nocodb_list_records to discover row IDs. Optionally limit returned fields. Read-only.

baseId.description: Base ID from nocodb_list_bases, prefixed with p, for example p_abc123def.

tableId.description: Table ID from nocodb_list_tables, for example m_abc123def.

recordId.description: Numeric row ID of the record to retrieve.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use exact names from nocodb_get_table.

tools.name: nocodb_count_records
tools.description: Count records in a NocoDB table, optionally filtered by a where clause. Use this to know the total number of records before paging through a large table with nocodb_list_records. Read-only.

baseId.description: Base ID from nocodb_list_bases, prefixed with p, for example p_abc123def.

tableId.description: Table ID from nocodb_list_tables, for example m_abc123def.

where.description: NocoDB filter string, same syntax as nocodb_list_records. Omit to count all records.

viewId.description: Optional view ID to count records through a specific view's filters.
